questions.subject: Analog Circuits
questions.question: A non-inverting operational amplifier circuit has $R_1 = 5\,\text{k}\Omega$ connected from the inverting pin to ground and feedback resistor $R_f = 45\,\text{k}\Omega$. The closed-loop voltage gain $A_v = 1 + \frac{R_f}{R_1}$ is ________.

questions.title: GATE EC — Analog | Small Signal Analysis of BJT/MOSFET
questions.subject: Analog Circuits
questions.question: A common-emitter BJT amplifier with unbypassed emitter resistor $R_E$ introduces negative feedback that results in:
options: Increased input resistance and stabilized voltage gain
Decreased input resistance and increased voltage gain
Zero output resistance and unstable gain
High distortion and lower bandwidth

structuredOptions.label: A
structuredOptions.text: Increased input resistance and stabilized voltage gain
structuredOptions.html: Increased input resistance and stabilized voltage gain

structuredOptions.label: B
structuredOptions.text: Decreased input resistance and increased voltage gain
structuredOptions.html: Decreased input resistance and increased voltage gain

structuredOptions.label: C
structuredOptions.text: Zero output resistance and unstable gain
structuredOptions.html: Zero output resistance and unstable gain

structuredOptions.label: D
structuredOptions.text: High distortion and lower bandwidth
structuredOptions.html: High distortion and lower bandwidth

questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Analog Circuits):

An unbypassed $R_E$ provides series-series negative feedback. This raises the input impedance ($R_{\text{in}} \approx r_\pi + (1+\beta)R_E$), stabilizes gain against $h_{fe}$ variations, and widens bandwidth.
